title: Connecticut (CT) Counties
text:
Connecticut (CT) Counties

FIPS codes for Connecticut.
FIPS State Code: 09
 

Enter the U.S. country code (01) followed by the state and county code.

For example, for Tolland County, enter 
01-09013
.
